Their sentence names the king who will kill them, בְּיַד֙ נְבֽוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר (oshb:Jer.29.21, byte) — a resh-family spelling of Nebuchadnezzar’s name, distinct from the nun-family forms spelled earlier in this same letter at oshb:Jer.29.1 and oshb:Jer.29.3. I am he who knows, and am witness,” (web:Jer.29.23); a ketiv/qere note sits in this same closing verse: ketiv הו ידע against qere הַיּוֹדֵ֥עַ (oshb:Jer.29.23, WLC, single-witness), alongside a separate OSHB exegesis note at the same verse (single-witness apparatus, not text bytes).
